items.title: How many listeners does each approach actually need as the list grows?
items.description: A per-button approach needs one listener attached for every single item, and needs to re-run every time an item is added. A delegated listener needs exactly one, regardless of how many items exist now or get added later. Drag the slider to see how the two approaches diverge as a todo list grows.
items.compute: const perElementListeners = params.numItems; const delegatedListeners = 1; return { perElementListeners, delegatedListeners };
